name: Farrukhabad

queries.query: फर्रुखाबाद भू नक्शा जमीन नक्शा तहसील आधिकारिक खसरा नक्शा उत्तर प्रदेश
queries.scope: Find city/district official land records and current cadastral map viewer.
queries.result: Official Farrukhabad district land-records pages link to Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh and identify Tehsil offices Farrukhabad Sadar, Amritpur and Kaimganj. Official UP BhuNaksha selectors list district 159 and three tehsils; no parcel polygon response was requested or retained.

queries.query: Farrukhabad district land records official BhuNaksha map Farrukhabad city Uttar Pradesh
queries.scope: Confirm official district-to-state record route and geo-referenced map status.
queries.result: The official district service routes to UP Bhulekh; the Uttar Pradesh public digitization dashboard has Farrukhabad district/tehsil village map linking and georeference status. The interactive map shell defaults to Agra; no Agra or Farrukhabad parcel geometry was reused as a city sample.

officialSources.observation: Official district Record of Right page links UP Bhulekh and identifies local tehsil offices.
Hindi district land-record page links to the same state service and local offices.
Current public map shell includes District, Tehsil, Village and Plot No controls; initial page defaults to Agra.
Official district digitization dashboard has Farrukhabad cadastral map sheets/village linking and georeference status.

serviceChecks.observation: Viewer rendered; default selectors point to Agra, not target city.
Static client code identifies level selector POST, village-based map extent, plot-at-coordinate route and WMS plot display.
Returned three administrative tehsils; no parcel or owner data requested.

freshResearch.geometryDecision: No full city-bound parcel polygon retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Farrukhabad district revenue-map coverage with Sadar, Amritpur and Kaimganj tehsils.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public selector request at district code 159 returned three tehsils (Amritpur 00831, Kaimganj 00830, Farrukhabad 00832); district dashboard documents cadastral-map digitization. No point-to-village mapping or full polygon was retrieved for the WUP city locator.

technicalBlocker: The viewer exposes map selection and WMS display; no anonymous full-polygon response was verified. The current viewer page defaults to Agra, so its displayed default map cannot be attributed to Farrukhabad.
remainingUncertainty: Exact WUP point revenue village and whether that urban locality is represented in an accessible village map; legal cadastral keys and full geometries were not queried.
nextStep: If continuing, resolve the point to an official Farrukhabad Sadar village and use only a documented full-geometry endpoint with safe parcel ID selection.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Farrukhabad district administration directs land-right records to UP Bhulekh and lists the district tehsil offices. UP BhuNaksha’s public selector confirms district 159 and city-name tehsil code 00832; the state dashboard records map-digitization status. This establishes local record/map services, not an exact city polygon sample.
